name: catalog_search
description: Search catalog filelist/timeline/bodyfile with a regex; returns the match count and one page of matching lines (limit, offset). When the page is not all of them, every match is kept in a file under your scratch and named (all_matches).

limit.description: Matching lines to return in this call (default 50); the count is always of all of them

offset.description: Skip this many matches first, to page through a result (next_offset gives the next page)

catalog.description: The catalogue directory under catalog/ when there is more than one (default: the only one)

partition.description: The filesystem's directory in the catalogue, p<first sector> (e.g. p2048), when there is more than one (default: the only one)
